# The Age of Gemini: How New Google Cloud Agents Will Transform Work

The video analyzes Gemini's ads at Work 2026: the passage from conversational AI to agents performing tasks. It shows the agent's reasoning cycle, the isolated sandbox, the identity and gateway for security, the cost controls, the agent's memory at work, and cases such as Sompo insurance and a NASA satellite.

Maurício Yokoyama Issei video, published on October 10, 2026 (7 min 56 s).
Watch: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hub4sB4yYss

_The video and the transcript are in Portuguese. The minutes between brackets, such as [04:12], point to the excerpt of the video._

## From conversation to execution

The video deals with the passage of the conversational AI, in chat format, to the autonomous and agency AI with Gemini [00:00]. The AI ceases to be an oracle that answers questions and becomes an execution engine [00:20].

According to the video, from October 2026 the AI ceases to be only a text tool and starts to act as a workforce, performing complex tasks on behalf of those who manage it [00:20].

## The Ascent of Agents

In the traditional model, it was necessary to give commands all the time, with prompt engineering. With agentic AI, a broad objective is delegated and autonomous reasoning takes care of the steps [01:04].

An agent of Gemini is not a loose language model: it is an integrated system that plans, uses external tools, connects to company systems and delivers a ready product [01:24]. It is the transition from passive assistance to proactive action [01:46].

## The birth base

Gemini's managed agent works inside a sandbox. With an API call, the system creates an isolated Linux environment at the operating system level, where the agent writes and tests code, browses the Internet and manages files [01:46]. According to the video, this runs on models like Gemini Flash [02:06].

Also according to the video, there is freedom of framework: LangGraph for complex flows, CrewAI for collaborating agents and LlamaIndex to connect the AI to internal data [02:27].

Whatever the framework, the agent runs on a continuous cycle [02:49]:

1. It understands the request [02:49].
2. Set up a plan and choose the tools [02:49].
3. It acts on its own [03:09].
4. It summarises the answer [03:09].

According to the video, a complex task can consume from 100,000 to 3 million tokens [03:09].

## Safety and cost in scale

In companies, the platform needs to answer: who is the agent, what he can touch and where his actions are registered [03:31]. Each agent receives a unique and encrypted identity, with the lowest possible privilege, and all traffic passes through an Agent Gateway, a firewall made for AI networks [03:31].

In hardware, the TPU 8i system delivers a price-to-performance ratio 80% better than the previous generation, which makes it viable for dense corporate loads [03:52].

Continuous loops in a large model would end any budget [04:14]. So there is intelligent routing, which sends each task to the right size model, and real-time spending limits. The price per token has fallen 98% since 2024 [04:35].

## The AI as a co-worker

The paradigm shift is to treat AI as a digital coworker: you can mention an agent in corporate chat or put him in a meeting invitation, and he acts with a defined identity, along with the team [04:56].

The integrated agent uses four types of memory. It retains the context of the company, remembers how to do recurring tasks and understands the history of the workflow, without needing to reexplain the rules [05:16].

The golden rule is to ensure confidence in the accuracy of each response. Tools such as the knowledge catalog map business definitions, so the agent responds anchored in the actual data rather than guessing internal terms [05:39].

## The Real Impact

The video cites uses in telephone operators, banks and retail: agents who solve network failures in real time and detect fraud to cancel suspicious payments. This frees people for creative and advisory work [05:59].

Japanese insurance company Sompo created over 10,000 custom agents for its 34,000 employees [06:41]. According to the video, the development time of a specialized model fell from one week to one day [06:41].

The agentic AI also arrived in space: optimized models run on a NASA satellite, analyze images of the Earth and send summaries to the ground teams [07:02].

The final reflection: the age of age is not only accelerating tasks, but rethinking what an organization can accomplish when performing on a scale is no longer the problem [07:24].

## Frequently Asked Questions

In a sandbox: an isolated Linux environment at the operating system level, created by an API call, where the agent writes code, browses and manages files [01:46].

### How does the platform control the cost of agents?

With intelligent routing, which sends each task to the right size model, and spending limits in real time [04:14].

## About the video

**The work now begins in the prompt window!** In this explanatory video, we analyzed in detail the release of **Gemini Agent** at the event *Gemini at Work 2026*, showing how Google Cloud is leading the transition to the era of **corporate autonomous agents**.

Understand the evolution of Vertex AI to **Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform**, a unified infrastructure developed to build, scale, govern, and optimize agents capable of performing complex tasks with complete security and corporate control.

---

💡 **What you will learn in this video:**

• **The New Gemini Agent:** How the universal working agent works that plans, executes code, manages files and connects systems from a single prompt.  
• **Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform:** The evolution of the Vertex AI bringing the **Agent Studio** (low code pipes), **Agent Development Kit (ADK)** and **RAG Engine** to connect private corporate data.  
• **Persistent Memory and Orchestration:** The role of **Memory Bank** and **Agent Runtime** to maintain long-term context in multiple-day workflows.  
• **Governance and Rigorous Security:** Like the **Agent Sandbox** is isolated at OS level and **Agent Gateway** ensure access control, audit and firewall against data leak.  
• **Integration in Google Workspace:** The Gemini acting like *inline* in Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets and Slides, including as a self-employed teammate (*coworker agent*).  
• **Financial Cost Control:** Optimizing budgets with **Smart Routing** and ceiling of spending in real time (*spend caps*).
